history.note: Whole-client CPU/RAM and selected GPU; not inference-process isolation. GPU values hold the last driver snapshot only while fresh. CPU temperature is absent without a supported actual sensor. Means/peaks in summary preserve all observations despite ring eviction.

summary.drift_note: Early/late windows can overlap on runs shorter than 120 seconds. Differences describe observed workloads/environment; they do not establish thermal throttling, sustained model speed or hardware capability.
summary.coverage_note: Time-weighted coverage excludes gaps longer than four sampling intervals or one second, whichever is larger. Peaks are maxima of observed samples, not guaranteed physical peaks. Ring eviction does not change all-run aggregates.
